subject: Brightline — embedding + rerank migration orchestration checklist
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Brightline — embedding + rerank migration orchestration checklist

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a lightweight orchestration checklist to make the embed -> rerank migration low-risk and auditable from both sides. Key goals: produce a reproducible seed index, run rerank evals against a shared sample set, and a low-lift backfill plan to avoid query regressions during cutover.

High-level milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (now): finalize SOW and test account access (procurement + SSO).
- Week 1: schema & index mapping review; export sampling and seed index generation.
- Week 2: rerank sample evals + quality gates; define rollback triggers.
- Week 3: backfill execution (staggered waves) with monitoring hooks.
- Week 4: cutover + post-cutover QA window.

Immediate asks for Brightline:
1) Confirm the primary embedding index target (vectorstore: Pinecone vs. self-hosted Milvus) and any host constraints.
2) Provide a 1–2k sample of production queries and the top-10 results for the last 30 days (we'll use for rerank seed evaluation).
3) Grant a dev API key and a sandbox S3 bucket for index artifacts.

Attachments: Brightline_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a first-pass task list. Copying Karthik and Mina for infra/ops and evaluation scope.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
-----

From: Jamie Torres <jamie@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anya Singh <anya@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline — embedding + rerank migration orchestration checklist

Marissa —

Appreciate the checklist. A couple quick points:
- Brightline prefers managed Pinecone for now; our procurement team is open to alternatives but for timelines Pinecone is the path of least friction.
- I've uploaded a 1.5k query sample and the top-10 hit lists to the shared Drive folder you linked. Folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Embed-Rerank-Brightline
- Can you confirm whether Redwood needs server-side access to our Pinecone project, or will API-key-based ingestion be sufficient?

Procurement is looped (procurement@brightlinehealth.com) on SOW approval.

Thanks,
Jamie
PM—Search & Recommendations
Brightline Health
-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline — embedding + rerank migration orchestration checklist

Thanks, Jamie — this is perfect. Short answers:
- Pinecone is fully supported; API-key ingestion is fine for the seed index. If you prefer the Redwood-managed approach we can provision a read-only service principal for observability during the backfill. We'll plan for API-key first and iterate.
- For the rerank evals we recommend the 1–2k query sample you uploaded plus an additional 200 synthetic edge-case queries (we can generate these if you want).

I've converted the checklist into a MAP below with owners and dates. Action items: 
1) Marissa — finalize SOW and return to procurement (target: 2027-05-06).
2) Brightline (Jamie) — grant dev API key & share Pinecone project details (target: 2027-05-07).
3) Karthik — prepare ingestion scripts and index mapping template; verify tokenization & embedding dims (target: 2027-05-09).
4) Mina — prepare rerank eval harness and baseline metrics dashboard; define quality gates (target: 2027-05-12).
5) Monica — schedule a pre-cutover smoke test and PagerDuty rotation for the backfill week (target: 2027-05-18).

I'll attach the updated SOW and a small CSV mapping we use for index field mapping.

Attachments: Brightline_SOW_v2.pdf, index-mapping.csv

On accessibility: procurement can sign via the DocuSign link in related_links.

Marissa
-----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jamie Torres <jamie@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline — embedding + rerank migration orchestration checklist

Jamie / team —

Quick technical note on the Pinecone choice and backfill approach:
- Agree Pinecone is easiest for Day 0. We'll provide a small ingestion wrapper (Python, 150 lines) that handles batched upserts + metadata fields we need for rerank signals.
- For the backfill we propose staggered waves by document date (3 waves) to keep query latency stable. Each wave will run with a canary traffic split (5% traffic) and monitor retrieval+rerank latency + top-k score drift.
- Important: please confirm the expected doc sizes and whether you have an existing dedupe key. That avoids index bloat during the backfill.

I'll drop the ingestion sample into the Drive folder by EOD.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
-----

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jamie Torres <jamie@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline — embedding + rerank migration orchestration checklist

Jamie —

I'll prepare the rerank eval harness and attach a small sample set (rerank-eval-samples.jsonl) so we can run initial nDCG/MRR checks against current production vs. Redwood's reranker. Proposed metrics: nDCG@10, MRR@5, and a qualitative error bucket for hallucination/regression types.

Mina Haddad
Applied ML — Quality & Evaluation
Redwood Inference
-----

From: Jamie Torres <jamie@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Fri, 6 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline — embedding + rerank migration orchestration checklist

All good — procurement signed the SOW via DocuSign and I've shared Pinecone API keys in the Drive (folder link above). I've also added a doc that lists our dedupe key (field: external_id) and average doc payload size (~3.2KB).

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the ingestion sample and rerank samples.

Jamie

[Forwarded message included above]
